title: OECS Pricing Definitions
description: The manufacturer's own published pricing for this model — the Manufacturer's Suggested Retail Price (MSRP), never a distributor/reseller/installer price.

regionalPrice.description: An MSRP amount, optionally scoped to one region/market.

region.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, or a broader grouping such as 'EU' when the manufacturer prices by group rather than country. Omit when a single price applies globally.

pricing.description: The manufacturer's MSRP for this model. Some manufacturers don't publish a fixed price at all (negotiated, on-request, or varies too much to state); use pricingModel to say so honestly rather than guessing a number.

pricingModel.description: 'fixed' — one or more MSRP prices are published, given in prices, optionally broken down by region. 'enquiry' — manufacturer doesn't publish a fixed price (negotiated, on-request, or otherwise not a single published number); see notes for how to get a quote.

prices.description: Manufacturer's Suggested Retail Price(s). A single entry with no region for one global MSRP, or multiple region-scoped entries when price varies by market. Only present when pricingModel is 'fixed'.

notes.description: Free-text context, e.g. how to request a quote, or what an on-request price depends on.
